name: Yuki
source:
The Main Character (aka MC) is the human protagonist of Obey Me!. Their default name is Yuki in English, and Ibuki (伊吹) in Japanese, but the player can change this name — alongside their birth date — at the start of the game.

[From [url=https://obeymewiki.com/wiki/Main_Character]The Obey Me Wiki[/url]]
